reason: A monitoring plugin that reads DeepSeek account balance data, optionally exposes it to the agent, and presents balance, pricing status, and estimated session cost in a configurable sidebar badge.

summaries.zh: 监测 DeepSeek 账户余额并在侧边栏显示余额、峰谷计价状态和当前会话估算费用，同时提供会话内查询工具。
summaries.en: Monitors a DeepSeek account balance and displays balance, peak/off-peak pricing status, and estimated session cost in a configurable sidebar badge with an in-session query tool.

capabilities: Reads the DeepSeek account balance through the official balance API
Provides an in-session balance query tool
Displays balance, pricing status, and estimated session cost in a sidebar badge
Optionally injects cached balance information into model context
Polls the balance API periodically with caching and request serialization
